title: Three non-programmer Claude skills: 'i-have-adhd' (answer-first, numbered steps, no filler; 27.9k stars), 'no-AI-slop' (strips 20+ AI tells, lists changes, scores AI-ness), and hyperframes (Claude writes a file that renders to MP4 motion graphics, 21 templates, runs in Claude Code)

tools.name: i-have-adhd
tools.detail: github ayghri/i-have-adhd, 27.9k stars; forces answer-first, numbered steps, cuts 'great question' filler

tools.name: No AI Slop

tools.detail: Claude writes a spec file; hyperframes renders MP4 with motion graphics, animated captions, soundtrack; 21 templates; requires Claude Code

claims: A skill is just an instruction file: drop it in once and Claude follows it forever
i-have-adhd has ~27k stars and is for everyone, not just ADHD
No AI Slop catches 20+ patterns and tells you exactly what it changed; can scan text and rate AI-ness
hyperframes produces finished MP4 videos with no code written by you; 21 templates; replaces an editing subscription
All three are free; first two install in ~30 seconds
how_to_steps: Install i-have-adhd skill into Claude (30 s)
Install No AI Slop skill (30 s)
For hyperframes: set up in Claude Code, pick a template, have Claude write the composition file, render to MP4
